# Contract: interaction-motion-study

SumitCraft addition. Category: design. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Specify trigger, states, timing, interruption, keyboard and focus, reduced motion and recovery, then build and browser-check a runnable study.

## Use it for
- "how should this menu behave"
- "motion spec with reduced motion"

## Not for
- looping video (code-loop)

## Accepted inputs
An interaction to design.

## Deliverables
SPEC.md, study page, check report and screenshots.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)

Optional:
- none

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
Local only: reads and writes files on this machine.

## Cost-sensitive operations
None.

## Workflow
1. Write the spec first
2. Build the smallest study page
3. Check behaviour
4. Watch it
5. Report

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Timing and easing feel (provisional options)

## Quality checks
- 8 behaviour checks pass on the study, 6 fail on the hover-only version
- watched at normal and reduced motion

## Common failures
- Hover-only triggers
- lost focus

## Limitations
- Checker covers disclosure patterns; screen-reader output not verified

## Reproducible example
examples/disclosure-menu.
